about: Golden scenarios for the Dryrun judge. Written, hashed and timestamped (golden.lock.json) before the first run; never edited after, never used to tune the prompt. H1 to H3 are held out: they have no expected label and are run once.
flow: Each case is a case on the deployed contract: the owner registers the rule set once, the author adds the scenario with a stake of 1 GEN, and a third account calls run. The label is read back with get_case. A case whose expected label is UNCLEAR is added with an expectation of BLOCK, because an author may only expect ALLOW or BLOCK; UNCLEAR is what the validators find, not what an author predicts.

promo.name: Golden: promotion
promo.rules: Members may not promote other projects in the main channel.

five.name: Golden: five community rules
five.rules:
1. Be respectful, no harassment.
2. Members must be 18 or older.
3. No spam.
4. Members may not promote other projects in the main channel.
5. Moderators must give a reason for removing a post.

mods.name: Golden: moderators
mods.rules: Moderators must give a reason for removing a post.
